title: Why Do Fireflies Glow In The Dark? Nature's Flashlight!

lines.text: Look out into the dark summer grass! Tiny yellow stars are blinking and dancing!
lines.caps: Look into the dark *GRASS! | Tiny yellow stars are *BLINKING | and *DANCING!

lines.text: Fireflies! But how do tiny bugs carry neon flashlights inside their tummy?
lines.caps: *FIREFLIES! But how do bugs | carry neon flashlights inside their *TUMMY?

lines.text: Inside the firefly's tail lantern sits a special chemical called luciferin!
lines.caps: Inside the firefly's *TAIL | sits a special chemical called *LUCIFERIN!

lines.text: When oxygen from the air mixes with this chemical and an enzyme called luciferase...
lines.caps: When oxygen from the *AIR | mixes with this chemical inside their *BODY...

lines.text: FLASH! A burst of bright, emerald-gold light shines out into the darkness!
lines.caps: *FLASH! A burst of bright | emerald-gold light shines into the *DARKNESS!

lines.text: A household lightbulb wastes ninety percent of its energy making hot heat!
lines.caps: A household bulb wastes *NINETY PERCENT | of its energy making hot *HEAT!

lines.text: A firefly's light is one hundred percent cold light—zero energy wasted!
lines.caps: A firefly's light is *COLD LIGHT— | zero energy *WASTED at *ALL!

lines.text: They blink in rhythm like secret Morse code to talk to their beetle friends!
lines.caps: They blink in *RHYTHM | like secret Morse code to talk to their *FRIENDS!
